definitions.explanation: The act of bringing a chaotic or problematic situation under control. Often used when a situation has spiraled out of hand and needs to be contained or resolved.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収拾|しゅうしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: To work on bringing the situation under control.

examples.japanese: ⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がり→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧、{収拾|しゅうしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかなくなった。
examples.english: The chaos spread and became impossible to control.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いて→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収拾|しゅうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}った→図る：12006_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: The president personally held a press conference to try to bring the situation under control.

notes:
USAGE:
Often appears in news and formal contexts describing crisis management. The most common pattern is {収拾|しゅうしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない (to be out of control, beyond settling).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {収拾|しゅうしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない (to be out of control)
- {収拾|しゅうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧ (to attempt to bring under control)
- {収拾|しゅうしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (to handle the resolution)
- ⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収拾|しゅうしゅう} (resolution of the situation)

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧: collection, gathering — same reading, but means to collect items (e.g., ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧ "garbage collection")
- {収拾|しゅうしゅう} uses {拾|しゅう} (pick up), not {集|しゅう} (gather)
